shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md
if [ -f AGENTS.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; fi
rg --files -g 'SKILL.md' -g '*tdd*' .lore . 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,110p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|conversation list|Conversation list\" specs src/transport/*.test.ts src/transport/**/*.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,110p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
rg -n '"'^### 4'"\\.|"'^### 5'"\\.|"'^## 6|''^## [0-9]+'"' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '210,430p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n 'specs/.*#|@spec|spec:' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListHandler.test.ts | head -80
ls scripts/*spec* scripts/*anchor* 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git diff --stat
sed -n '34,62p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,80p' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "docs(transport): document session list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
